name: Swan Dive
text: You soar through the air and into the water, using your momentum to propel yourself forward. You intentionally leap or otherwise fall into a body of water, taking no falling damage regardless of the distance, and then Swim up to your Speed. Until the end of your turn, when you roll a success on an Athletics check to Swim you get a critical success instead, and when you roll a critical failure you get a failure instead.
